trust_decision.summary: Notebook-cell trust (metadata.trusted) may be conferred only by data this application itself wrote to the clipboard: pasteFromSystemClipboard keeps trust only when SystemClipboard.matchesLastWrite confirms the clipboard text equals the last write recorded by ClipboardImpl.setData, and otherwise inserts deep copies with trust stripped per cell type.

landing_point.why: The advisory is about cells pasted from the system clipboard; NotebookActions.pasteFromSystemClipboard is the only function that reads cell data from the system clipboard (packages/notebook/src/actions.tsx:1508) and forwards the parsed cells straight to addCells (packages/notebook/src/actions.tsx:1518) without normalising trust metadata.

fix_sites.entry_point: SystemClipboard.IClipboard.getData / the added matchesLastWrite (public interface of @jupyterlab/apputils)
fix_sites.module_kind: low-level public API (clipboard primitive, apputils package)

fix_sites.entry_point: SystemClipboard.getInstance().clear / setData on the ClipboardImpl singleton
fix_sites.module_kind: private implementation of a public interface

fix_sites.entry_point: SystemClipboard.getInstance().setData, reached from NotebookActions.copyToSystemClipboard and cutToSystemClipboard (packages/notebook/src/actions.tsx:1411-1443)

NotebookActions.pasteFromSystemClipboard (also the notebook:paste command at packages/notebook-extension/src/index.ts:2905 and the toolbar paste button at packages/notebook/src/default-toolbar.tsx:191)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: packages/apputils/src/clipboard.ts:265-291 (ClipboardImpl.setData, the only writer of the provenance record the fix's check reads; the interface is extended at packages/apputils/src/clipboard.ts:145-147)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The apputils clipboard is generic infrastructure also used for plain-text copies (cell id and cell link at packages/notebook-extension/src/tool-widgets/activeCellToolWidget.tsx:119-141), so a solver can argue that deciding whether Jupyter cell data is trustworthy belongs to the notebook action and no provenance bookkeeping belongs in the clipboard primitive.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Cells copied in one open notebook and pasted into another must keep their trusted outputs rendered, and a local copy->paste must still make the cellsPasted signal report previousInteraction 'copy'/'cut' rather than null; the fix threads a separate clipboardInteractionValues array (fix.diff:104-107) so the trust-stripped copies never reach the interaction comparison.

O6_input_shapes: a cells array (nbformat.IBaseCell[]) recovered by JSON.parse of clipboard text, not a plain string
code cells whose output is display_data and code cells whose output is execute_result, both carrying text/html
cells with metadata.trusted true, with metadata.trusted false, and with no metadata object at all
markdown and raw cells that carry metadata.trusted (deleted, because trust is only valid on code cells; same convention as changeCellType at packages/notebook/src/actions.tsx:3275-3282)
the stripOutputs:true option, which strips outputs but must not leave trust behind
clipboard content written by this application (local provenance) versus content written outside it

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second cell-insertion transport (drop between notebooks) that inserts cell JSON straight into the model, preserving metadata.trusted
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The maintainers already wrote this exact path with the comment 'We preserve trust status of pasted cells by not modifying metadata', so a sibling that reuses it for another external transport differs only in where the data comes from.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: another deprecated-but-public paste button that calls NotebookActions.pasteFromSystemClipboard without the settings gate or without forwarding options
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Two other deprecated toolbar factories (cut/copy at packages/notebook/src/default-toolbar.tsx:131-173) still duplicate the command logic, so a third divergent caller is in keeping with the file.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second SystemClipboard.IClipboard implementation (extension-provided or a non-secure-context fallback clipboard) that records last writes differently or not at all
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: IClipboard is an exported public interface implemented outside this repository, and the fix adds a required method to it, so an out-of-tree implementation is a natural place for the same mechanism to be incomplete.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: application-clipboard paste() falling back to the system clipboard when the app clipboard is empty, reusing addCells without any provenance check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: paste() and pasteFromSystemClipboard() already share addCells and the same stripOutputs shape, so unifying them is a plausible follow-up refactor.

O9_family: Insufficient verification of data authenticity (CWE-345) enabling stored cross-site scripting (CWE-79) through notebook cell trust metadata

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Strip or delete metadata.trusted from every cell inside NotebookActions.pasteFromSystemClipboard, which makes all local copy->paste untrusted (the cross-notebook trusted-output case) and turns the cellsPasted previousInteraction into null.

out_of_scope_notes: The in-app drag-and-drop cell copy at packages/notebook/src/widget.ts:3520-3523 also inserts cell JSON with metadata.trusted intact, but it is a Lumino drag transport, not the system clipboard named by this advisory, so it was not evaluated as a route.

The vulnerable path is gated by the useSystemClipboardForCells setting, which defaults to false (packages/notebook-extension/schema/tracker.json:891-895); its description advertises cross-tab/window cell copy, a use case the fix's per-page last-write record cannot authenticate.
